posts.title: Triple odds of ischemic colitis for endurance athletes in hospital data
posts.excerpt: Published Oct 15, 2026, 1:05 PM: Researchers at the American College of Gastroenterology's 2026 meeting in Nashville found ischemic colitis in 5.5% of hospitalized patients with documented endurance…
posts.body: Published Oct 15, 2026, 1:05 PM: Researchers at the American College of Gastroenterology's 2026 meeting in Nashville found ischemic colitis in 5.5% of hospitalized patients with documented endurance activity, versus 2.0% of matched controls, roughly triple the odds, with risk climbing for ultra-distance events [per Medical Daily](https://www.medicaldaily.com/endurance-athletes-ischemic-colitis-acg-2026-479868). The authors called it a signal, not a verdict: a conference abstract, not peer-reviewed, drawn from hospital records only, and they named steady hydration, caution with ibuprofen around races, and gradual distance buildup as sensible habits rather than tested fixes.

posts.body: A new Mother Jones investigation finds ICE separating children from their parents in the country's interior and deeming them unaccompanied, routing kids who have families into [ORR custody](https://www.muellershewrote.com/p/headlines-for-october-14-2026). posts.title: A calm heart the night before is tied to faster marathon times
posts.excerpt: Published Oct 14, 2026, 7:00 AM: Of the 73 male marathoners tracked with a single-lead ECG patch the night before the 2025 Padua Marathon, those with a lower minimum sleeping heart rate and stronger…
posts.body: Published Oct 14, 2026, 7:00 AM: Of the 73 male marathoners tracked with a single-lead ECG patch the night before the 2025 Padua Marathon, those with a lower minimum sleeping heart rate and stronger vagal modulation finished faster the next day, independent of age, BMI, and training hours, [per the Oct 12 study in Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/cardiovascular-medicine/articles/10.3389/fcvm.2026.1932814/full). The authors read the pattern as a readiness signal: stronger vagal tone overnight may mark more restorative sleep, and that recovery is the preparedness that shows up the next morning.

posts.body: Published Oct 14, 2026, 4:25 AM: Chainguard announced Checks on Wednesday, a verification engine that pulls CI out of its old spot after the pull request and runs it inside the agent's working loop, delivering signed, trusted verification in seconds, per its [PR Newswire release](https://www.morningstar.com/news/pr-newswire/20261014ne71672/introducing-chainguard-checks-reinventing-continuous-integration-for-the-agentic-era). Every passing run produces a signed attestation tying together the environment, test result, and commit, so a merge gate can verify it and merge without re-running the test suite.

posts.title: No clear link between load and fiber-type muscle growth
posts.excerpt: Across eight muscle-biopsy studies, every comparison of training load against fiber-type growth saw its confidence interval cross zero, per a Frontiers in Physiology meta-regression. The authors call…
posts.body: Across eight muscle-biopsy studies, every comparison of training load against fiber-type growth saw its confidence interval cross zero, [per a Frontiers in Physiology meta-regression](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/physiology/articles/10.3389/fphys.2026.1953601/full). The authors call the fiber-specific trend preliminary: too few studies and wide intervals to build a program on.

posts.title: Decision models cut AI agent token costs
posts.excerpt: A new class of "decision models" trims an AI agent's toolset to the few tools that fit each request, returning a calibrated choice plus a confidence score with no generated text and no embeddings or…
posts.body: A new class of "decision models" trims an AI agent's toolset to the few tools that fit each request, returning a calibrated choice plus a confidence score with no generated text and no embeddings or index. [In the author's benchmark](https://dev.to/aws/cut-ai-agent-token-costs-with-decision-models-for-tool-selection-2320), selecting first matched the right tool on every query while cutting chat tokens by roughly two-thirds.

posts.body: The 34-year-old actor was pronounced dead at 1:32 p.m. Monday at his Brownsville residence, Cameron County Justice of the Peace Cyndi Hinojosa said. His [representative confirmed](https://www.usatoday.com/story/entertainment/tv-streaming/2026/10/13/rj-mitte-cause-of-death-suicide/92223732007/) the cause Monday evening.

posts.title: OPPO taps Manus to bring agentic AI to smartphones
posts.excerpt: A single prompt to OPPO's AI Mind Pilot can run a multi-step job on the upcoming Find X10 series, like pulling flight and hotel bookings into a day-by-day itinerary. Local tasks such as finding or…
posts.body: A single prompt to OPPO's AI Mind Pilot can [run a multi-step job](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/media-release/oppo-partners-manus-bring-agentic-ai-experiences-smartphones-6455481) on the upcoming Find X10 series, like pulling flight and hotel bookings into a day-by-day itinerary. Local tasks such as finding or renaming files stay on the device and are never shared with Manus, which has to ask permission before anything is uploaded for external processing.

posts.title: Endurance tests aren't interchangeable
posts.excerpt: In 186 fit young adults, a shared endurance factor explained only about 60 to 70% of scores across six standard endurance tests, with running tests clustering together and rowing tests clustering…
posts.body: In 186 fit young adults, a shared endurance factor explained only about 60 to 70% of scores across six standard endurance tests, with running tests clustering together and rowing tests clustering together instead, [per an October 1 study in Frontiers in Physiology](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/physiology/articles/10.3389/fphys.2026.1973746/full). Rowing performance leaned on strength and power, especially upper-body, so a 12-minute row is no stand-in for a 12-minute run when the question is where your running fitness stands.

posts.title: Chicago names former officer suspect in 1960 killing of 8-year-old
posts.excerpt: Chicago police say former officer Thomas Francis McInerney abducted and killed 8-year-old Gloria Kowalewicz as she walked to church in November 1960. The case sat unsolved for 65 years until…
posts.body:
Chicago police say former officer Thomas Francis McInerney abducted and killed 8-year-old Gloria Kowalewicz as she walked to church in November 1960.
The case sat unsolved for 65 years until investigators submitted her preserved coat to the FBI for [genetic genealogy](https://wegotthiscovered.com/true-crime/65-years-later-chicago-police-name-their-own-officer-as-suspect-in-8-year-olds-killing/), which led them to McInerney's family tree.

posts.title: Factory acquires Mentlio for intelligent token allocation
posts.excerpt: On October 9, Factory announced it was acquiring Mentlio (YC S26) to fold intelligent token allocation into its software-engineering platform, per its own announcement. Mentlio's trick is in-harness…
posts.body: On October 9, Factory announced it was acquiring Mentlio (YC S26) to fold intelligent token allocation into its software-engineering platform, per [its own announcement](https://factory.com/news/mentlio). Mentlio's trick is in-harness model routing and context compression, built to spend tokens where they pay off and to measure where the usage actually created value.

posts.title: 21shares lists Europe's first Anthropic pre-IPO ETP
posts.excerpt: European investors can now trade Anthropic's implied pre-IPO valuation through the 21shares Anthropic Synthetic ETP (ticker CLAU), listed on the Vienna MTF, per 21shares' announcement. The exposure…
posts.body: European investors can now trade Anthropic's implied pre-IPO valuation through the 21shares Anthropic Synthetic ETP (ticker CLAU), listed on the Vienna MTF, per [21shares' announcement](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/10/13/3379343/0/en/21shares-launches-europe-s-first-pre-ipo-synthetic-anthropic-etp.html). The exposure is purely synthetic, built on swaps tracking a Kaiko index of Binance perpetual futures rather than any Anthropic shares.

posts.title: Overdrive app seemingly makes PS5 games, DLC free
posts.excerpt: Videos since October 12 show Overdrive, a new jailbreak app, browsing a store-style catalogue on the PS5 that lists download sizes and review scores where the prices should be, per Insider Gaming.…
posts.body: Videos since October 12 show Overdrive, a new jailbreak app, browsing a store-style catalogue on the PS5 that lists download sizes and review scores where the prices should be, per [Insider Gaming](https://insider-gaming.com/ps5-jailbreak-app-overdrive-seemingly-makes-games-and-dlc-free/). Its catalogue includes current releases like Battlefield 6, 007: First Light, Forza Horizon 5, and Black Myth: Wukong.

posts.title: CWS: custody over 6 months as child deportation orders top 10,000
posts.excerpt: Answering the October 1 HHS report, Church World Service says sponsor-reunification policy changes have made release nearly impossible, pushing the average custody stay to over six months, citing…
posts.body: Answering the October 1 HHS report, Church World Service says sponsor-reunification policy changes have made release nearly impossible, pushing the average custody stay to [over six months](https://cwsglobal.org/press-releases/new-hhs-report-on-unaccompanied-children-overlooks-harm-caused-by-current-policies/), citing government data. In one case it describes, a father who finished every sponsor-vetting protocol was detained and deported by ICE two days before reuniting with his son.

posts.title: Samsung takes up to $150 off monitors and storage
posts.excerpt: The 55" Odyssey Ark 2nd Gen and the 34" Odyssey OLED G8 G85SD headline Samsung's own monitor-and-memory sale, which takes up to $150 in instant credits off select displays and ends October 18, per…
posts.body: The 55" Odyssey Ark 2nd Gen and the 34" Odyssey OLED G8 G85SD headline Samsung's own monitor-and-memory sale, which takes up to $150 in instant credits off select displays and ends October 18, per [DealNews](https://www.dealnews.com/Samsung-Monitor-Memory-Deals-Up-to-150-off-free-shipping/22275088.html). Storage is in the sale too, including the 990 Pro SSD and the T7 Shield portable drive.

posts.title: Trump calls Houthis 'misbehaving' as Riyadh flights halt
posts.excerpt: Repeated Houthi missile attacks on Saudi airports, Riyadh's King Khalid International and Dammam's King Fahd International among them, have killed at least 18 people, and Riyadh's airport is shut…
posts.body: Repeated Houthi missile attacks on Saudi airports, Riyadh's King Khalid International and Dammam's King Fahd International among them, have killed at least 18 people, and Riyadh's airport is shut through Saturday, [per Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/liveblog/2026/10/13/iran-war-live-trump-says-houthis-misbehaving-as-riyadh-flights-halted). Airlines are pulling out in turn: Etihad cancelled all Abu Dhabi–Riyadh flights through October 19, and Qatar Airways suspended its Riyadh and Dammam service.

posts.title: Meta launches Muse Wonder models to challenge Anthropic and OpenAI
posts.excerpt: Muse Wonder will soon power Meta's Muse personal agent for subscribers, while the more powerful Muse Wonder Full is available through Muse Code, per Reuters. Meta calls the pair its most capable…
posts.body: Muse Wonder will soon power Meta's Muse personal agent for subscribers, while the more powerful Muse Wonder Full is available through Muse Code, [per Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/meta-releases-muse-wonder-ai-models-challenge-anthropic-openai-2026-10-12/). Meta calls the pair its most capable models yet, after a fourteen-month overhaul of its AI efforts.
